'''''Cruciata pedemontana''''', the '''Piedmont bedstraw''', is a species of plant in the [[Rubiaceae]]. It is native to the southern and central [[Europe]], the [[Black Sea]] Basin, and southwestern and [[Central Asia]] from [[Turkey]] to [[Iran]] to [[Kazakhstan]]. It is also naturalized in parts of the [[United States]] (south-central and eastern parts from [[Texas]] to [[New York (state)|New York]], plus the northwest from [[Washington (state)|Washington]] and [[Oregon]] to [[Montana]]).<ref name="judydelph">[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=51755 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families, ''Cruciata pedemontana'']</ref><ref>[http://bonap.net/MapGallery/County/Cruciata%20pedemontana.png Biota of North America Program, ''Cruciata pedemontana'']</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Cruciata pedemontana [Crocettona piemontese] - Flora Italiana|url=http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=cruciata+pedemontana|access-date=2021-10-08|website=luirig.altervista.org}}</ref>

''Cruciata pedemontana'' is an erect herb up to {{convert|30|cm|abbr=on}}, covered with stiff hairs. Leaves are broadly ovate, usually four per node. Flowers are tiny, rarely more than {{convert|1|mm|abbr=on}} across, axillary, pale yellow.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Flora Vascular - Toda la informacin detallada sobre la Flora Vascular {{!}} - Especie: Cruciata pedemontana {{!}} BioScripts.net|url=https://www.floravascular.com/index.php?spp=Cruciata%20pedemontana|url-status=live|access-date=2021-10-08|website=www.floravascular.com|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120527174149/http://www.floravascular.com/index.php?spp=Cruciata%20pedemontana |archive-date=2012-05-27 }}</ref>

==Varieties==
Two varieties are recognized (as of May 2014):<ref name="judydelph"/>
*''Cruciata pedemontana ''var''. pedemontana''
*''Cruciata pedemontana ''var''. procumbens'' <small>(Asch.) Soó</small> - [[France]] and [[Italy]] (including [[Corsica]] and [[Sardinia]])
